title: Wyoming ranch visited by Queen Elizabeth II hits market for $24.5M
summary_full: The Quarter Circle Lazy B Ranch, spanning 1,542 acres in Wyoming, is now on the market for $24.5 million. This family-owned property has been in the Wallop family since 1889 and hosted notable guests like Queen Elizabeth II. The ranch features a luxury lodge, multiple homes, and retains its panoramic mountain views and tranquility. Accessible to the town of Sheridan, the ranch offers both privacy and outdoor recreation opportunities.
